children: Idemitsu Kosan's earnings are likely to be supported by wider margins of export products, Jefferies analysts say in a report. Earlier this year, the Iran-related crude supply shock forced Japanese refiners like Idemitsu to slow operations and prioritize domestic supply. This headwind is now reversing as alternative crude procurement has restored utilization, the U.S. bank says. Idemitsu is likely to benefit from strong crude procurement and surplus export capacity, Jefferies says. A recovery in the Vietnam joint venture Nghi Son Refinery and Petrochemical is also a positive catalyst, the bank says. Jefferies raises its rating on Idemitsu to buy from hold and its target price to 2,200 yen from Y1,400. Shares are up 5.4% at Y1,626.5. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
